notes: Corrected the two verbless clauses: t024 and t030 belong respectively to predicative s014 and s018 under rule 53. The English clauses are inverted forms of “the acceptable time is now” and “the day of salvation is now,” so English word order does not place the copulas on the nouns.
The supplied determiners t025 and t031 remain with the anarthrous nouns s015 and s019 under rule 58.
